findings.statement: Bodies with a docs export but zero affairs
findings.definition: body_key present in the docs exports, absent from affairs
findings.opd: Many communes publish only per-meeting documents (minutes) and no affairs. Deriving 'virtual affairs' from meeting documents is part of the challenge; OPD numbers them 'V' + start date (e.g. SO consultations).
'V' + start date is OPD's virtual affair number (e.g. SO consultations), not a data error.

findings.statement: BE affairs whose begin_date is > 1 year off the year in their number
findings.definition: |year(begin_date) - year(number)| > 1; 2024-10-28 is a load timestamp; correction list results/repair/repair_BE_begin_date.tsv

adapter_lists.note: Apply the rows with counted=true (verified=true is the same; action is then the proposed action): tag_answer (set the category of OPD document opd_doc_id to target_category), extract_tag (extract the text of OPD document opd_doc_id, set target_category), fetch (fetch source_url, attach, set target_category). counted=false rows have action=review: tier identity_wording_only (Jura: no date check) and tier review (review_reason) are for a person. text_sha256 is the hash of the text the checks read; check_detail carries the route, identity and date class, the sha256 of the document read, the extractor and a quote of at most 200 characters.
adapter_lists.precedence: Where a list in results/repair names the same affair, the adapter list wins over the older OCR candidate rows (results/repair/repair_<BODY>.tsv, action=ocr); the Bern lists and the Valais retype_oral list have no adapter counterpart. All lists and the rule: results/repair/MANIFEST.json.

coverage.note: adapter rows count only when verified with a date check: tiers exact_doc_date (the document's own date equals an OPD event date), exact_any_printed_date (a printed date equals an OPD answer event and the document's own date, if read, lies within 30 days of one) or date_window (within the parliament's documented window); rows of tier identity_wording_only (Jura: OPD's answer events carry no date) and review rows are listed but not counted. image_only affairs were OCR candidates, not counted in the baseline of 3,107; they count once a text copy verifies.
